commands.summary: Renderer TypeScript build and browser bundle passed after moving cockpit shell calls behind the ForgeLink shell bridge.
28 renderer interaction tests passed, including a guard that the app prefers window.forgeLinkShell over the legacy Electron-shaped window.desktop bridge.

environment.process_note: OCX-021: renderer-native capabilities now flow through a ForgeLink-owned shell bridge. Electron exposes forgeLinkShell and keeps desktop as a compatibility alias; Tauri 2 can implement the same bridge without the cockpit taking new direct Electron dependencies.
